before_metrics.comment: exp-20260531-006 found a top-quantile-concentrated composite alpha_score edge (Q5-Q1 5d +0.56pp) but could not say which components drive it. This decomposes by component with within/across-day variance and an RS double-sort control.

change_summary: Decomposes the composite alpha_score forward-return edge by component on the same 3551 full-universe (day,ticker) observations across the canonical 3 windows. Three discriminators: (1) univariate quintile spread, (2) within-day vs across-day variance share (cross-sectional vs market-timing), (3) RS double-sort control (within relative_strength quintile bands). Result: relative_strength is the only robust cross-sectional driver (+0.81pp 5d, 3/3 windows, within-day share 0.87). breadth_alignment had a univariate +0.88pp spread but its residual after RS control collapses to +0.34pp (below floor) -> RS-collinear, not incremental. expectation_revision and post_earnings_drift are perfectly constant (0.5, distinct=1) -> 30pct of composite weight is inert. Conclusion: alpha_score is repackaged momentum; no component beats relative_strength, which the core entry rule already trades on.
decision_rule: A non-momentum component is incremental only if its pooled 5d top-minus-bottom quintile spread >= 0.005 AND within-day-dominant variation AND majority-positive windows AND the spread survives RS double-sort (residual_5d_spread_vs_rs >= 0.005). Accept if >=1 non-momentum component qualifies. If only trend/RS or RS-collinear components qualify -> observed_only_momentum_only_edge. If none -> observed_only_no_component_edge.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Is the composite alpha_score top-quantile forward-return edge driven by core momentum (trend+RS) or by independent non-momentum components?
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260531-006 (composite top-quantile edge, non-monotonic); exp-20260530-022 (filled-trade degenerate); exp-20260528-007 (expectation increment to ranking, no edge).
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Per-component score quantile vs forward return, with RS double-sort control.
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: >=1 non-momentum component with a clean cross-sectional 5d spread that survives controlling for relative_strength.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: load 3 ohlcv snapshots, sample every 5th day, score full universe PIT, decompose by component. 8 unit tests cover dispersion, within/across-day variance, RS double-sort, and judge branches.

hypothesis: The full-universe top-quantile alpha_score forward-return edge found in exp-20260531-006 is driven primarily by the momentum components (trend 0.30 + relative_strength 0.25) that the core entry rule already trades on, not by the expectation_revision / post_earnings_drift / theme_participation / breadth_alignment components.
next_evidence_needed: Close the cross-sectional ranking direction for NEW alpha: alpha_score = momentum (relative_strength), which the core entry already trades on, so there is no incremental edge to capture by reweighting. expectation_revision and post_earnings_drift are constant (0.5) in this universe -- 30pct inert weight; reviving the ranking surface needs genuinely populated non-momentum components (a data-population problem, same blocker as the frozen expectation direction), not a weighting change. This explains why raw monotonic alpha_score ranking failed promotion in the parallel paper-adapter line (exp-20260531-005): middle ranks carry only momentum-collinear noise.

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: only relative_strength carries a robust edge; the one non-momentum challenger (breadth) is RS-collinear; expectation/PEAD are constant. Landed as observed_only_momentum_only_edge.
